agentguardUrl.description: Base URL of the AgentGuard server reachable from this OpenClaw process. Defaults to http://localhost:8080; the Docker make-configure setup writes http://host.docker.internal:8080.

holdFailPolicy.description: What to return when /api/holds is unreachable or errors. 'deny' (default) blocks the tool call; 'allow' lets it proceed.

holdsEnabled.description: When true, before_tool_call synchronously calls /api/holds and may block. When false, hook reverts to async observation-only mode (events still ingested, no blocking).
